segments.an4.78:1.3: Atthi, bhikkhave, dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati, no paṭiggāhakato;
segments.an4.78:1.4: atthi, bhikkhave, dakkhiṇā paṭiggāhakato visujjhati, no dāyakato;
segments.an4.78:1.5: atthi, bhikkhave, dakkhiṇā neva dāyakato visujjhati, no paṭiggāhakato;
segments.an4.78:1.6: atthi, bhikkhave, dakkhiṇā dāyakato ceva visujjhati paṭiggāhakato ca.
segments.an4.78:2.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati, no paṭiggāhakato?
segments.an4.78:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, dāyako hoti sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo; paṭiggāhakā honti dussīlā pāpadhammā [paṭiggāhako hoti dussīlo pāpadhammo (syā. kaṃ. ka.) ma. ni.3.381 oloketabbaṃ].
segments.an4.78:2.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati, no paṭiggāhakato.
segments.an4.78:3.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, dakkhiṇā paṭiggāhakato visujjhati, no dāyakato?
segments.an4.78:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, dāyako hoti dussīlo pāpadhammo; paṭiggāhakā honti sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā.
segments.an4.78:3.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dakkhiṇā paṭiggāhakato visujjhati, no dāyakato.
segments.an4.78:4.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, dakkhiṇā neva dāyakato visujjhati, no paṭiggāhakato?
segments.an4.78:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, dāyako hoti dussīlo pāpadhammo; paṭiggāhakāpi honti dussīlā pāpadhammā.
segments.an4.78:4.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dakkhiṇā neva dāyakato visujjhati, no paṭiggāhakato.
segments.an4.78:5.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, dakkhiṇā dāyakato ceva visujjhati paṭiggāhakato ca?
segments.an4.78:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, dāyako hoti sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo; paṭiggāhakāpi honti sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā.
segments.an4.78:5.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dakkhiṇā dāyakato ceva visujjhati paṭiggāhakato ca.
segments.an4.78:5.4: Imā kho, bhikkhave, catasso dakkhiṇā visuddhiyo”ti.

lines: Dāyakato visujjhatīti mahapphalabhāvena visujjhati, mahapphalā hotīti attho.
So hi jūjakabrāhmaṇassa dārake datvā mahāpathaviṃ kampesi.
So kira dīghasumattherassa tikkhattuṃ piṇḍapātaṃ datvā maraṇamañce nipanno “ayyassa maṃ dīghasumattherassa dinnapiṇḍapāto uddharatī”ti āha.
So kira petadakkhiṇaṃ dento ekassa dussīlasseva tayo vāre adāsi.
Ekassa sīlavato bhikkhuno datvā pāpitakāleyevassa pāpuṇi.
Dāyakato ceva visujjhati paṭiggāhakato cāti ettha asadisadānaṃ kathetabbanti.
Visujjhatīti na kilissati, amalinā mahājutikā mahāvipphārā hotīti attho.
Jūjako sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo na hoti, tassa mahābodhisattassa attano puttadānaṃ dānapāramiyā matthakaṃ gaṇhantaṃ mahāpathavikampanasamatthaṃ jātaṃ.
Uddharatīti bahulaṃ pāpakammavasena laddhabbavinipātato uddharati, tasmā natthi mayhaṃ kiñci cittassa aññatthattanti adhippāyo.
Pāpitakāleyevāti “idaṃ dānaṃ asukassa petassa hotū”ti taṃuddisanavasena pattiyā pāpitakāleyeva.
Tadā kosalarañño pariccāgavasena ativiya dānajjhāsayataṃ buddhappamukhassa ca saṅghassa ukkaṃsagataguṇavisiṭṭhataṃ sandhāyāha “asadisadānaṃ kathetabban”ti.
